Append a section divider slide

Source: R/placeholders.R
append_section_slides.Rd

Adds one slide on the section layout role ("Section Header" in basic.pptx) with a title and text. That layout has no subtitle placeholder: a subtitle is placed in the text box, above text, so speclayouts written for templates that do have a subtitle keep all their text. This backs the section placeholder type:

Usage

append_section_slides(
  doc_o,
  title = NULL,
  subtitle = NULL,
  text = NULL,
  section_title = NULL,
  to_page = NA,
  doc_original = NULL,
  save_file = FALSE,
  layouts = placeholder_layouts(),
  metadata = NULL,
  role = "section"
)

Arguments

doc_o

Path to the .pptx file. Read when doc_original is NULL, and used to name the saved file.

title, subtitle, text

Text for the slide. Each may be a character vector or a list, one paragraph per element. NULL leaves it out.

section_title

Older name for title, used when title is NULL.

to_page

Page for the first slide; the others follow it. NA appends after the last slide.

doc_original

An optional officer::rpptx object to add to.

save_file

If TRUE, the deck is saved next to doc_o with a _<type> suffix.

layouts

The role lookup, see placeholder_layouts().

metadata

Optional named list of values for {token}s in the text, see apply_tokens().

role

The layout role to use.

Value

The modified officer::rpptx object.

Details

sec_safety:
  type: section
  title: Safety Summary
  subtitle: "Data cut-off: {cutoff_date}"
  text:
    - All treated patients

See also

append_section_header_slides() for the older title-only version.

Examples

deck <- tempfile(fileext = ".pptx")
print(officer::read_pptx(system.file("theme/basic.pptx", package = "autoslider.core")), deck)
doc <- append_section_slides(deck, title = "Safety", subtitle = "Data cut-off: 01-JAN-2026")
officer::slide_summary(doc, index = length(doc))$text
#> [1] "Safety"                    "Data cut-off: 01-JAN-2026"
